> Thanks for the ping. Rishi — high level: GreenWave is a strategic mid-market expansion and the added capacity is material. Treasury-wise, we generally standardize on Net45 for new upsell amendments unless finance approves longer. Marissa, can you confirm whether we can accept Net60 for this PO if they provide a signed PO and current tax documents?

Rishi / Lauren — we can make an exception to Net60 in this case subject to two things being completed before the invoice is issued:

1) We receive a formally signed PO referencing GW-6789 and the exact billing entity (company name + remit-to address).
2) We have a completed W-9 on file for GreenWave (or W-8/BEN if actor is non-US).

If those are provided, we’ll issue the invoice with Net60 terms and note the invoice in our AR system with the PO# for electronic matching. If the PO is late (after month-end), we may need to date the invoice on the day the PO is received — let us know if GreenWave needs specific invoice dating for internal accounting.

Attaching our standard W-9 for convenience.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
